$comment: Static brand contract for the Concord landing page. Equivalent of the eval harness's `contract.mjs init` invariants, established without reading the forbidden vismith/ directory. check.mjs enforces zero deviation against this file (CHK-02 analog).
name: concord-landing

ink.$note: Low-saturation cool ink neutral ramp (hue ~222deg, sat 6-16%). ink-0 is paper; ink-9 is deepest ink.

accent.$note: Cobalt blue. The only saturated color on the page.

fonts.mono: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'SF Mono', Consolas, Menlo, monospace
fonts.$note: Inter is pinned by the brand brief. No network in this environment: Inter resolves via local install, otherwise falls back to Segoe UI/system-ui (declared degradation in README). Mono is allowed only for code, SQL, traces, hashes, and measurement values.

invariants.topNav: Persistent sticky top navigation present at load and on scroll; contains the wordmark and the primary CTA.
invariants.primaryCta: Exactly one primary action ('Install the extension'), rendered as the same component everywhere; at most one secondary action per viewport ('Read the docs' text link in hero).

sectionRhythm.$note: Vertical section padding at desktop width must resolve within [80,128].

invariants.heroSpecificity: Hero headline must stop being true if the product name is swapped for a different product.

checks: CHK-01 every hex/rgb color in styles.css is a contract token (alpha overlays must derive from a token)
CHK-02 body font-family resolves to Inter with declared fallback stack; mono used only in code/trace/measurement contexts
CHK-03 exactly one primary CTA action; at most one secondary action in hero
CHK-04 sticky top nav contains wordmark + primary CTA
CHK-05 section vertical rhythm tokens resolve within 80-128px at desktop
CHK-06 no banned hype words; no banned patterns in markup
CHK-07 text/background contrast pairs from computed token pairs meet 4.5:1 body, 3:1 large
CHK-08 pricing table exists below hero; trust strip contains only verifiable-style elements (repo link, license), no avatars/ratings
